messages.content:
You are a clinical terminologist. You expand a clinical concept into the
specific named things a medical record would actually store for it.

Expand this clinical concept into concrete searchable names.

Concept: eGFR based on serum creatinine and cystatin C
Record domain: observation

For a drug class, list the generic ingredient names that belong to the class.
For a diagnosis, list the specific condition names, including the common
sub-types a record might code instead of the general term.
For a laboratory test, list the names and common synonyms of the measurement.

List what belongs to the concept in general clinical practice. Do NOT try to
guess what this particular site happens to record; that is looked up separately.

Return JSON only:
{"names": ["empagliflozin", "dapagliflozin"], "note": "one short line"}

Give between 1 and 15 names.

response.text:
```json
{
  "names": [
    "eGFR (creatinine and cystatin C)",
    "eGFRcr-cys",
    "Estimated glomerular filtration rate from creatinine and cystatin C",
    "eGFR CKD-EPI (creatinine-cystatin C)",
    "eGFR by CKD-EPI creatinine-cystatin C equation",
    "Estimated GFR by Creatinine and Cystatin C",
    "Glomerular filtration rate/1.73 sq M.predicted by Creatinine and Cystatin C-based formula",
    "Glomerular filtration rate, estimated from creatinine and cystatin C",
    "CKD-EPI Creatinine-Cystatin C eGFR",
    "eGFR Creatinine-Cystatin C",
    "eGFR calculated from serum creatinine and cystatin C"
  ],
  "note": "Laboratory observations and panel calculations for combined creatinine and cystatin C estimated GFR (predominantly CKD-EPI equations)."
}
```
